contract: GET /api/search/authors answers 401 without a token, 400 when q is absent or repeated as an array, and 200 with a null body when q is empty, without contacting Audnexus. A non-empty q searches the fixed external Audnexus host.
exceptions: normal is not applicable: the non-empty-q success path calls the fixed external host api.audnex.us, so only the offline auth, validation and empty-q paths are asserted.

Unexecuted here: the built-in provider success paths (google, itunes, openlibrary, fantlab, audiobookcovers, audible) call fixed external hosts, so their result parsing and fuzzy fallback are not asserted by this packet; every deterministic offline path is asserted.

invariants.contract: GET /api/search/authors answers 401 without a token, 400 when q is absent or an array, and 200 with a null body for q= (empty), calling no external host.
